The '''Magister of Trade''' was a position in the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]], dealing with interplanetary trade. In the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Sinya Deboora]] held the post until being outed as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]].
